reviews.text: Mike and alison are absolutely fantastic- looked after my 10 year old bunny for a week and he is back home binkying around already and clearly so well looked after. Could not recommend them highly enough :)
My hamster came home scared kept staying still then moving then staying still then died today we got him home earlier but I don’t fully blame furry friends hotel I just wanted to share my experience.

My guinea pigs have stayed here twice now and we will be using them many more times in the future! The family are lovely and polite and clearly love animals. Our guinea pigs come back relaxed and happy which is a very good sign!

We were very nervous to leave our pets for the first time as they were our first pets and we had only had them for a few months, and have no family nearby to watch when we are away. But we felt at ease very quickly and trust 110% our guineas are safe and happy when we are away. Definitely recommend!
First class service from this lovely couple. They were more than happy to keep looking after my guinea pigs after an emergency hospital stay when down south.
My guineapigs go regularly for a spa day and always come home so clean. We'll groomed and smelling lovely.  Alison and team are so lovely and look after the small animals with love and attention.

Our rabbit Snowy was at Furry Friends Hotel for 2 weeks and she had a lovely time. Mike and Alison were so friendly and they were great at updating us on how she was doing - she came back very relaxed. Would highly recommend Furry Friends to anyone looking to board their rabbits.
Mike took such great care of my rabbit. Fantastic service every time!

Boarded our 2 wee bunnies here for 5 nights and cannot be more happy with the service. Lovely care given, bunnies looked very relaxed when we picked them up. Cute photo updates on instagram and they even got to have a wee visit outside in the nice weather. It was so nice to know that they were being looked after so well, allowing us to enjoy our time away worry free!
10/10 - will be boarding with Furry Friends Hotel again, thank you!
Super friendly couple, vet knowledgeable about rabbits, 100% trust them to take care of our prince pickles. He had a great time.
Many thanks for your lovely review.

This place is grand. Anytime I leave town with the family the family guinea pig stays here. We are always super happy with the service and the prices are fair and reasonable. Recommend this place 5/5.

Took my kids guinea pigs to get their nails trimmed, including aromatherapy. Mike and Alison were lovely, and did a grand job. The guinea pigs came home, and were so relaxed, they didn't leave their pet carrier for 3 hours. Their nails look fantastic. 2 content piggles, and one happy owner. Highly recommend.
My little gunieapig Blondie had a lovley holiday here. She was given 5 star care. While she has her visit she had a full make over getting her fur cut and her nails cut too.
